summary: QXO, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing its subsidiary Titanium MergerCo, Inc. commenced tender offers and consent solicitations for TopBuild Corp.'s $500M 4.125% Senior Notes due 2032 and $750M 5.625% Senior Notes due 2034. The tender is for any and all cash and seeks consent amendments to eliminate change-of-control provisions, restrictive covenants, certain defeasance conditions, and most events of default. Consummation is conditioned on closing the Merger Agreement dated April 18, 2026, for QXO's acquisition of TopBuild. No board recommendation or advisor is mentioned. Watch for regulatory clearance and concurrent merger closing as the risk-arb angle.
